subject: CWE-79
object: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
object_canonical: improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting')

subject: CWE-79
object: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.
object_canonical: the product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

subject: CWE-74
object: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
object_canonical: improper neutralization of special elements in output used by a downstream component ('injection')

subject: CWE-74
object: The product constructs all or part of a command, data structure, or record using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify how it is parsed or interpreted when it is sent to a downstream component.
object_canonical: the product constructs all or part of a command, data structure, or record using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify how it is parsed or interpreted when it is sent to a downstream component.
